title: 第5章 父母
novel_title: 巫师：让你学知识，你杀穿万界？
content_zh:
里奥家族的府邸是一座占地广阔的庄园，深灰色的岩石垒砌出威严的主堡，庭院中喷泉折射着夕阳余晖，各色奇异的发光植物沿着路径点缀。

    仆人们早已列队恭候，动作整齐划一，训练有素。

    “少爷，到了。”老福特拉开车门，躬身。

    伊森踩着踏板下车，目光扫过眼前熟悉又陌生的府邸。

    他微微颔首，在管家和仆役的簇拥下步入主堡。

    帝都，里奥侯爵府邸主会客厅。

    与领地城堡的厚重温暖不同，这里的空间更为开阔深邃。

    高耸的穹顶垂下巨大的水晶灯，光芒冷冽明亮，映照着抛光如镜的黑曜石地面与墙上悬挂的巨幅先祖画像。

    伊森跟随管家穿过空旷的长廊，脚步声在寂静中被放大。

    推开厚重雕花木门，厅内的景象映入视野。

    主位上是他的父亲，斯林·里奥侯爵。

    身形挺拔如松，并未穿戴显赫的爵服，只一身深色猎装，仿佛刚从巡视中归来。

    他指间夹着一支秘银烟斗，淡青色的烟雾袅袅升起，面容被烟雾遮掩了大半，但那股久居上位的、如同实质冰壁般的威严与疏离感无声地弥漫。

    侯爵夫人坐在侧位，保养得宜的脸上带着温婉得体的微笑，一身考究的宫廷裙装，裙摆铺开在宽大座椅上。

    两侧则坐着几位旁系的长辈叔伯。

    当伊森步入时，他们纷纷起身示意。

    “父亲，母亲。”伊森走到中央站定，右手抚胸，行了一个标准的贵族礼，举止无可挑剔。

    “回来了。”里奥侯爵目光穿透烟雾扫过伊森全身，“那件事，处理得不错。有侯爵继承人的样子了。”

    “谢父亲。”伊森微微垂首。

    “路上还顺利？”侯爵夫人开口，声音温和，带着关切，“累了吧？让人给你准备些蜜糖热奶。”

    “谢母亲关心。路上一切安好。”伊森答道。

    “好了，仪式前这几日，不要离开内城范围。”侯爵收回目光，重新专注于烟斗，“测试前最后一天，会有人接你。福特会安排好一切。”

    侯爵夫人接口道：“凝神药剂可按时服用了？若效果不足，我就再买一支。”

    “母亲费心，药剂效用极佳。”伊森答道。
content_en:
The Leo family's mansion is a vast manor, with a majestic main castle built out of dark gray rocks. The fountain in the courtyard reflects the afterglow of the setting sun, and various strange luminous plants are dotted along the path.

    The servants were already waiting in line, their movements uniform and well-trained.

    "Master, we're here." Old Ford opened the car door and bowed.

    Ethan stepped on the pedal and got out of the car, his eyes scanning the familiar yet unfamiliar mansion in front of him.

    He nodded slightly and walked into the main castle surrounded by the butler and servants.

    In the imperial capital, the main reception room of Marquis Leo's residence.

    Different from the thick warmth of the territorial castle, the space here is more open and deep.

    A huge crystal lamp hangs from the towering dome, its light is cold and bright, reflecting the polished obsidian floor and the huge portraits of ancestors hanging on the wall.

    Ethan followed the housekeeper through the empty corridor, his footsteps amplified in the silence.

    Pushing open the thick carved wooden door, the scene in the hall came into view.

    At the head of the table is his father, Marquis Slim Leo.

    His body was as tall and straight as a pine tree, and he was not wearing any distinguished royal uniform, only a dark hunting suit, as if he had just returned from a patrol.

    He held a mithril pipe between his fingers, and light cyan smoke curled up. His face was mostly obscured by the smoke, but the majesty and alienation that had been on top for a long time, like a solid ice wall, filled the air silently.

    The Marquise sat on the side, with a gentle and decent smile on her well-maintained face. She was wearing an elegant palace dress with the skirt spread out on the large seat.

    On both sides sat several elder uncles from the collateral lineage.

    When Ethan walked in, they all stood up and signaled.

    "Father, mother." Ethan walked to the center and stood still, with his right hand on his chest, he performed a standard aristocratic salute and his behavior was impeccable.

    "Back." Marquis Leo's eyes penetrated the smoke and swept across Ethan's body. "That matter was handled well. He looks like the heir to the Marquis."

    "Thank you, father." Ethan bowed his head slightly.

    "Was the journey going well?" the Marquise said, her voice gentle and concerned, "Are you tired? Have someone prepare some hot honey milk for you."

    "Thank you for your concern, mother. Everything is fine on the road." Ethan replied.

    "Okay, don't leave the inner city in the past few days before the ceremony." The Marquis withdrew his gaze and focused on the pipe again. "On the last day before the test, someone will pick you up. Ford will arrange everything."

    The Marquise said: "Can you take the concentration potion on time? If it is not effective enough, I will buy another one."

    "Mom, the potion is very effective." Ethan replied.
